query: UPDATE public.content_blocks SET data = jsonb_set(data, '{items}', (data->'items') || '[{"desc": "نُصمم أنظمة أتمتة ذكية (Telegram + AI) لاستقبال البلاغات، فرز البيانات، وتنبيه فرق العمل فوراً دون تدخل بشري.", "title": "أتمتة العمليات بالذكاء الاصطناعي", "outcome": "سرعة استجابة فائقة", "mechanism": "سير عمل LiftDesk الذكي"}]'::jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE key = 'services.catalog' AND locale = 'ar'; UPDATE public.content_blocks SET data = jsonb_set(data, '{items}', (data->'items') || '[{"desc": "We design intelligent automation (Telegram + AI) to receive reports, sort data, and alert teams instantly without human intervention.", "title": "AI Operations Automation", "outcome": "Instant Response Speed", "mechanism": "LiftDesk AI Workflow"}]'::jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE key = 'services.catalog' AND locale = 'en'; SELECT id, key, locale, data->'items' FROM public.content_blocks WHERE key = 'services.catalog';
